title: Concept: Lockfile resolves a dependency from a git remote
description: package-lock.json declares a lockfile entry fetched from a git remote instead of a registry tarball, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The code is outside the registry's signing and provenance controls, so the registry integrity model does not apply to it.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through package-lock.json (npm).
risk: The code is outside the registry's signing and provenance controls, so the registry integrity model does not apply to it.
